full_page.content:
Page 6 Cont.
Nov. 7 Thanks. Mrs. Pearl (Marg. ) Slater - 44- Quaker - Enrolled last April 18 when given up as hopeless internal cancer .... is here To-day not too bad, but "must go back for other operation". En- rolls again as a perpetual member.
Vera Peaches - 47 - "Evangelical" - lung trouble ....
Florence DeMeyre - 28 - from Kiefer .... Expects to see Dr .- tumor.
8
Francis Fafelski - 6 - poleo - since October 12 .. Enrolled in S.M.A.
Page 7
Nov. 10th Baby Mary N. Miseveth - 21 mo. - in Cottage Hosp. - pneumonia and maningitis, Dr's have very little hope - Orthodox father has not been practical- promises .... Enrolled perpetual.
13 Richard LaFrance - 7 - burned last Saturday, unconscious ever since - Enrolled % phone perpetually.
11 Thanks. Mrs. Norma Deratany - 44 - heart trouble and a stroke seven yrs. ago. Unable to walk and almost blind; was enrolled in Ser. Masses and shortly after started to improve; is here To-day quite well - to enroll a son, reported "missing in action".
14 Donna Hay - 19 - went away 42 months ago - and has never been heard from since. Enrolled in Ser. Masses this evening.
15 John Fanti - 26 - now in Florida - writes his wife and two Children - Expects to go over seas .... fears "no return".
Wm. Breckner - 30 - dying of cancer in St. Clair Shores ... " too late" Teresa Farmer ....
Page 8 Nov. 16
Frank Toth - 23 - mental disorder. . Father seemingly a good man naturally; but never learned much about religion, consequently has never fostered it personally.
Harold Havel - 26 - wounded in four-days battle in S. Pacific - now in Calif. Hospital.
Peter Luk Pastionelli - 29 - losing use of eyes for several years; going to Chicago To-night .... Enrolled perpetually.
